episodes.synopsis: Mitsuki’s dreams come true when he is isekai’d to another, magical world! Once he meets the kindly priestess Menou, his grand adventure is sure to begin… right?
episodes.title: The Executioner

episodes.synopsis: When Akari unveils a terrifying ability, Menou grants her a stay of execution... temporarily, at least. A foolproof method of delivering death is just a train ride away.
episodes.title: The Lost One

episodes.synopsis: An ordinary trip by train goes off the rails when Menou and Akari are caught in the crossfire of a terrorist attack on Princess Ashuna.
episodes.title: Taboo in [Red]

episodes.synopsis: A priestess pure, just and strong—or a villain reviled by all? Menou knows precisely which one she wants to be, and she has one person to thank for her singularity of purpose.
episodes.title: The Ancient Capital Garm

episodes.synopsis: As Momo investigates a rash of disappearances, Menou and Akari spend a final day together. But sinister forces move in the shadows, and the upcoming ritual isn’t as it seems…
episodes.title: Goodbye

episodes.synopsis: A ominous plot unfolds, trapping Akari and Menou in its center. But help is coming from the outside — and from within, too, if Menou can play her cards just right.
episodes.title: [Regression: Memories, Soul, Spirit]

episodes.synopsis: The dreaded Pandemonium provides the people of Libelle a stark reminder of the power of Pure Concept — and it reminds Menou of what’s at stake in her quest to kill Akari.
episodes.title: Port City of Libelle

episodes.synopsis: A dangerous drug has flooded the streets of Libelle, but Menou isn’t the only one on the case. Who will uncover the truth first, and what is Manon Libelle planning?
episodes.title: Monstrine

episodes.synopsis: As Momo and Menou unearth the source of monstrine, Akari takes matters into her own hands. But there is more to the mysterious Manon Libelle than she bargained for...
episodes.title: At the Evening Ball

episodes.synopsis: Manon reveals a startling connection to Menou’s mentor and an even more startling power, but she's far from the greatest danger lurking inside Libelle… or even inside herself.
episodes.title: The Daughter of a Lost One

episodes.synopsis: What are the consequences of an Executioner failing to eliminate her target? For Menou and Akari, the answer is more terrible than anything they could have imagined.
episodes.title: Pandæmonium

episodes.synopsis: Chaos reigns in the fight against Pandemonium, and with ether in short supply, Menou is running out of options to defeat the looming evil. But through Akari, there is a way…
episodes.title: The Duo’s Journey
